citations.assessment: The Bavli explicitly has Rabbi Matun in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi in the palm-branch discussion.
The question about learning from Elisha and doubled Matun address appear together.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The Heilprin entry gives this exact incident and the Bavli calls the woman a Kutite. The naming-practice argument remains Heilprin’s, without collapsing distinct namesakes.
